01Selected work
  1. i.

    Blocking

    Large, flat planes of color set the composition before any detail goes in. Hard-edged shapes and halftone texture give these three pieces their bold, graphic mood.

    Illustration · Digital Painting · Photoshop
  2. ii.

    Coloring

    Coloring is where flat shapes gain depth, with layered tones and textures building up the light and mood. Each shape is refined and recolored until the whole piece reads as one cohesive image.

    Digital Painting · Collage · Editing
  3. iii.

    Character Work

    Character design gives a figure a readable silhouette, a consistent face, and a personality that holds across poses and expressions. These pieces explore that through model sheets, expression studies, and bold color choices.

    Design · Coloring · Linework · Typography
  4. iv.

    Mockups

    Poster and social media content mockups, designed in Figma and Canva. Includes a Title IX student awareness campaign for UConn USG: a poster, a four-card social series and a six-slide guide.

    Socials · Figma · Canva
